kind: source-based SAS/XMS ownership and failure-contract investigation; no runtime acceptance

findings.evidence: Original linear loops return void and dispatch through c_sas_hw_at / c_sas_store. There is no returned whole-range failure status.
findings.conclusion: Not a drop-in replacement for a fallible synchronous lease provider.

findings.evidence: On xtrn2phy failure, selected PM or VM paths call biosDoInst; PM without selectors returns without a value/status.
findings.conclusion: Removing range preflight changes the lease no-guest-entry/failure contract. Preserve it until a source-owned equivalent is implemented and verified.

findings.evidence: Original descriptor uses a host pointer decremented across fields; non-i386 move assumes GetVDMAddr(0,0)+linear address is affine. Current code reads numeric descriptor bytes and uses forward SAS copying.
findings.conclusion: Do not restore affine pointers over the admitted noncontiguous mapping model merely to remove F dependencies. Historical R1933-R1941 evidence corroborates the mechanism but does not prove cancellation equals original AX/BL errors.

findings.evidence: Requests SESSION_CANCELLATION_REQUESTED on the current product session.
findings.conclusion: Not a B memory primitive. Keep product cancellation authority outside B; original failure propagation remains a separate design obligation.

findings.evidence: These five exported operations use lease mechanics, numeric ranges and bounded buffers. They do not call CPU registers, xtrn2phy or SAS directly.
findings.conclusion: Eligible next complete implementation cohort for B, using the existing typed lease binding. Preserve zero-length results, captured owner, per-operation admission, chunk boundaries, partial commit, overlap direction and errors.

findings.evidence: Uses CPU access bits, xtrn2phy, c_sas_memory_size and original c_sas_* operations. Forward-copy preflights source and destination before executing original forward order; WRITE lease hydration is not equivalent.
findings.conclusion: Cannot migrate unchanged to B. Do not add a CPU forwarding table or pretend a renamed header removes this implementation dependency.
